normalized_failures.expected_meaning: Preflight may validate dependencies and return only the closed typed report; it must not accept caller operations or return modules, loaders, controls, or other runtime-capable objects.
normalized_failures.observed_meaning: Both _preflight_gate(operation) helpers accepted an ordinary callback that returned the internal loader and v9 harness ModuleType. The returned loader then loaded the v9 subject driver without a root freeze/static gate or additional load-order event.

prior_reproducer_and_new_counterfactual_.prior_reproducer: Candidate-v19 module-published control objects and raw runtime helpers exposed semantic loading before root validation.
prior_reproducer_and_new_counterfactual_.remaining_gap: The zero-call preflight helper retained a caller callback and returned its selected result.

prior_reproducer_and_new_counterfactual_.prior_reproducer: Call _preflight_gate with a function that returns the supplied loader and harness, then use the returned loader.
prior_reproducer_and_new_counterfactual_.new_required_counterfactual: The successor preflight API accepts no callback or operation parameter, returns only a strict canonical report/data projection, and contains the loader/module only inside a lexical scope that no callable can return.

longest_valid_causal_prefix.basis: Candidate-v20 failed before freeze or subject launch.

previously_closed_failure_classes.note: The runtime operation boundary is simplified and closed; the remaining defect is isolated to preflight result selection.

added: root-bound closed runtime operation dispatch with no authority object return
removed: raw runtime semantic loaders and diagnostics
remaining_overreach: preflight callback API can return internal loader and harness objects

decision_evidence.trigger: Runtime authority was simplified successfully, but the same caller-selected callback pattern remained in preflight and exposed internal objects before empirical progress.

next_action.rule: Preserve v20. Replace preflight callback helpers with a zero-argument closed report builder that validates the full closure, computes the deterministic cases internally, and returns only strict JSON-compatible report data. No loader, module, callback, operation selector, or authority object may cross the lexical boundary. Retain all prior cases and require independent PRESEAL_PASS before canary.

nonclaims: This assessment is not a freeze, launch authorization, empirical result, clean matrix, qualification, or production-readiness claim.
